verdict.rationale: Discord documents a REST API, so a downloadable machine-readable spec is a fair question, but nothing in the evidence shows one exists. The probe found every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path returning 404. The llms.txt and markdown docs are documentation indexes, not an API spec, so they are adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
